content.text: The only MFN-style language in the document runs in our favour. Submitting a compliant finding.

input.quote: MSL agrees that MSL engineering will be priced to IBM on a "most favored customer" basis.
input.rationale: The sole most-favoured-nation provision in the Agreement runs in IBM's favour: MSL undertakes to price its engineering services to IBM on a "most favored customer" basis (Attachment 1, p1099). Searches for MFN triggers ("most favored", "no less favorable", "best price", "favorable", "match", third-party terms) and a review of the pricing provisions (§§ 7.1, 7.2, and the Markup Appendix) reveal no obligation on IBM to extend MSL any terms given to third parties or to match third-party offers. This meets the preferred position (no MFN burden on the customer, vendor-granted MFN welcome), so no redline is proposed.
